home.title: RadQC Suite
home.description: Radiation-dose and quality-control calculators for radiography, CT, mammography, fluoroscopy, ultrasound and MRI. Validated against Brazilian IN 54–91, ACR, AAPM and IEC references.
home.privacy: Runs entirely in your browser — measurements stay on the device, and the app works offline once installed.

meta.title: RadQC Suite
meta.description: Radiation-dose and quality-control calculators for medical imaging equipment.

extraoral.title: Extraoral — PKA / DAP / DFOV CBCT
extraoral.description: PKA indicator accuracy and representative DAP comparison (IN 94), plus CBCT DFOV vs reference and the DIN 6868-161 action level.

intraoral.title: Intraoral — ESD
intraoral.description: Entrance skin dose at the cone tip with backscatter, optionally compared against a local protocol limit.

tomography.title: Tomography (CBCT/CT) — CTDI / DLP / E
tomography.description: Weighted CTDI from center + peripheral readings, scaled to CTDIvol, then DLP and effective dose.

conventional.title: Conventional — ESD
conventional.description: Per-exam entrance skin dose for conventional radiography against IN 90/2021 Annex II references.

mammography.title: Mammography — MGD
mammography.description: Mean glandular dose with g·c and S-factor lookup; IN 54 conformity by PMMA thickness.

fluoroscopy.title: Fluoroscopy
fluoroscopy.description: Entrance dose-rate during fluoroscopy with IN 91 / RDC 330 caps for manual / automatic / high-rate modes.

qc/kvp.title: kVp accuracy
qc/kvp.description: Per-shot kVp deviation and reproducibility across the shot series; IN 56 tolerances.

qc/hvl.title: HVL — half-value layer
qc/hvl.description: Compare measured HVL against the IN 56 minimum for kVp and rectifier type.

qc/output.title: Tube output
qc/output.description: Tube output normalised to 1 m and reference kVp; compared to the IN 56 / IN 90 conventional range.

qc/timer.title: Exposure timer
qc/timer.description: Per-shot timer accuracy and reproducibility across the shot series; IN 56 tolerances.

qc/leakage.title: Leakage radiation
qc/leakage.description: Leakage dose-rate at 1 m from the tube housing under maximum-load conditions.

qc/accessories.title: Lead aprons & accessories
qc/accessories.description: Pass/fail scoring for lead aprons, thyroid collars, and gonadal shields.

qc/displays.title: Light box & monitor luminance
qc/displays.description: Light-box luminance and uniformity, plus diagnostic-monitor luminance and ambient illuminance.

qc/ct-number.title: CT number & uniformity
qc/ct-number.description: CT-number accuracy (water = 0 HU), uniformity, and noise from a water phantom.

qc/mammography-phantom.title: Mammography phantom
qc/mammography-phantom.description: ACR phantom scoring (fibres, masses, speck groups) with the ≥ 4/3/3 acceptance thresholds.

qc/ultrasound.title: Ultrasound
qc/ultrasound.description: Probe QC against per-probe baselines: penetration, axial/lateral resolution, dead zone, plus pass/fail visual checks.

qc/mri.title: MRI
qc/mri.description: ACR phantom QC: geometric accuracy, slice thickness, SNR, PIU, PSG, low-contrast.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Coverage summary across all calculators ported from the Modelos_CQ workbook. {implemented} of {total} implemented; {planned} planned.
audit.footer: Each calculator runs entirely in the browser; nothing is sent to a server. Use the print action on individual calculator pages to generate a LAUDO-style PDF for archival.

equipments.title: Equipment
equipments.description: Manage saved equipments. Each calculator can independently select which one to use. Stored locally on this device — nothing is sent to a server. Rectifier type affects calculator formulas; the rest is informational and shows up on printed reports.
equipments.empty: No equipments saved yet. Click Add new to create one.
equipments.selectPrompt: Select an equipment from the list to edit its fields.

fields.name: Name
fields.rectifierHint: Used by HVL minimum and beam-quality formulas.
fields.referencePkaHint: Representative dose from the equipment manual (IN 94 reference).
fields.referenceDfovHint: Reference DFOV from the CBCT manual.

extraoral.title: Extraoral
extraoral.description: Three QC checks for extraoral imaging. Indicator accuracy — verify the equipment's reported PKA against a measurement (IN 94). Representative DAP — compare a measured PKA to the manufacturer reference (IN 94). DFOV — validate CBCT dose against the reference and the DIN 6868-161 action level.

fields.dFocusReceptorHint: Distance from focus to the patient's image receptor.
fields.dFocusDetectorHint: Distance from focus to the chamber during measurement.
fields.beamWidthHint: Informational — P_KL is already integrated over this width.
fields.correctionFactorHint: Keep at 1 when no factor is declared.
fields.pkaMeasuredHint: DAP measured with the chamber or computed from the indicator tab.
fields.pkaReferenceDefault: Default from equipment: {value} mGy·cm². Representative DAP from the manual.
fields.pkaReferenceHint: Representative DAP from the equipment manual.
fields.kaHint: Kerma measured at the detector entrance.
fields.aHint: Distance from focus to the isocenter.
fields.bHint: Distance from focus to the measurement point.
fields.cHint: Horizontal diameter of the scanned volume.
fields.d: d — Radiation field diameter at measurement [cm]
fields.dHint: Horizontal diameter of the radiation field at the measurement point.

validation.hintMachine: Enter the machine-reported P_KA to compare.
validation.hintReference: Enter the manufacturer reference P_KA to compare.
validation.hintEquipment: Set the manufacturer reference P_KA on the selected equipment to compare.
validation.hintDfovRef: Enter the manufacturer reference DFOV to compare.

empty.pka: Enter measured P<sub>KL</sub>, focus–receptor and focus–detector distances, and field height to see the calculation.
empty.dap: Enter the measured P<sub>KA</sub> to see the comparison.
empty.dfov: Enter K<sub>a,i</sub>, focus–isocenter (a), focus–measurement (b), scanned-volume diameter (c) and radiation-field diameter (d) to see the calculation.

footer.pkaFormula2: Calculated P<sub>KA</sub> = Corrected P<sub>KL</sub> × field height × correction factor
footer.dapFormula: Deviation = |P<sub>KA,measured</sub> / P<sub>KA,reference</sub> − 1|. Compares against the manufacturer reference (Valor representativo de dose, IN 94).
footer.dfovTolerance: DIN 6868-161 deviation vs reference: ≤ 20% pass; 20%–40% fail; > 40% restriction.
footer.dfovAction: Action level (DIN 6868-161): DFOV ≥ {threshold} mGy — compliant; below that, image-quality action required.

intraoral.title: Intraoral — ESD
intraoral.description: Entrance skin dose at the cone tip. The chamber dose is scaled to the cone-tip distance via inverse square, then multiplied by the tissue backscatter factor.

fields.dFocusChamberHint: Distance from the focus to the chamber during the measurement.
fields.dFocusConeTipHint: Distance from the focus to the localiser exit (where the patient's skin is).
fields.backscatterHint: From the IPEN reference: 1.167 for 20 cm FFD, 1.208 for 27.5 cm FFD.
fields.referenceEsdHint: Local protocol limit or IN 56 reference dose to compare against.

validation.emptyHint: Enter a reference ESD to compare against.

intraoral.empty: Enter chamber dose, focus–chamber distance and focus–cone-tip distance to see the ESD calculation.

footer.l1: Dose at cone tip = chamber dose × (D<sub>focus–chamber</sub> / D<sub>focus–cone-tip</sub>)²
footer.l2: ESD = dose at cone tip × backscatter factor (FR)
footer.l3: Backscatter factors after Andrade & da Penha (IPEN): 1.167 at 20 cm FFD; 1.208 at 27.5 cm FFD.

conventional.title: Conventional — ESD
conventional.description: Entrance skin dose for conventional radiography. The chamber reading is corrected by the radiation-quality factor and scaled to the patient's skin via inverse square, then compared to the IN 90/2021 Annex II reference dose for that exam.

fields.thicknessHint: IN 90 standard for {exam}: {thickness} cm. Leave blank to use the standard.
fields.dFocusDetectorHint: Distance from focus to chamber during measurement.
fields.fidHint: Distance the exam was performed at.
fields.dTableReceptorHint: Distance from the table top to the image receptor.
fields.dWallStandReceptorHint: Distance from the wall-stand Bucky to the image receptor.
fields.radiationFactorHint: 1.2 for conventional, 1.4 for mammography, 1.3 for dental.

validation.emptyHint: No reference cap available for this exam.

conventional.empty: Enter chamber dose, focus–detector and FID distances, and the table- or wall-stand-to-receptor offset for the chosen station.

footer.l1: Focus–skin distance = FID − patient thickness − table/wall-stand-to-receptor offset
footer.l2: ESD = chamber dose × radiation factor × (D<sub>focus–detector</sub> / focus–skin distance)²
footer.l3: Reference doses: IN 90/2021 Annex II (maximum permitted ESD).

mammography.title: Mammography — MGD
mammography.description: Mean glandular dose for a standard-equivalent breast. Looks up g·c (AIEA HHS 17) by PMMA thickness and HVL, then the S factor for the target/filter combination, and multiplies by the entrance air kerma. Validated against the IN 54 tolerance for that PMMA thickness.

fields.pmmaOption: {pmma} mm — {breast} mm equivalent breast{cap, select, none {} other { (IN 54 < {cap})}}
fields.hvlHint: Pick the nominal HVL closest to the measured value.
fields.targetFilterHint: W/Al uses a PMMA-dependent S factor; others are flat.
fields.kitHint: From the chamber reading at the phantom surface. Use the LiF-derived value if applicable.

validation.in54Incomplete: Provide Kit and a valid PMMA/HVL/target combination.
validation.in54None: No IN 54 cap for this PMMA thickness.

mammography.empty: Enter the entrance air kerma (Kit) to see the MGD calculation.

footer.l2: g·c lookup: AIEA HHS 17 (pg. 114). S factors: AIEA HHS 17 Table on target–filter combinations and W/Al variant by PMMA. IN 54 tolerance is a strict upper bound on MGD per PMMA thickness.

tomography.title: Tomography — CTDI / DLP / E
tomography.description: Weighted CTDI from central + peripheral chamber readings, scaled to CTDIvol by pitch and length-corrected for short scans, then DLP and effective dose. Compares against the machine-displayed CTDIvol per IN 55.

fields.detectorLengthHint: Active length of the CT pencil chamber (typically 100 mm).
fields.dlpIndicatedHint: If provided, scan length is derived as 10·DLP / CTDIvol.

validation.emptyHint: Enter the indicated CTDIvol to check IN 55 indicator accuracy.

tomography.empty: Enter the five chamber readings (central + 3 h, 6 h, 9 h, 12 h) to see the dose calculation.

footer.l5: Length correction applies when scan length is shorter than the chamber's active length: factor = chamber-length / scan-length. Otherwise factor = 1.

fluoroscopy.title: Fluoroscopy
fluoroscopy.description: Entrance dose rate at the reference point during fluoroscopy. Compares against IN 91 / RDC 330 dose-rate caps for the selected operating mode and checks the accumulated-time alarm threshold.

fields.modeHint: Selects the IN 91 / RDC 330 dose-rate cap.
fields.dFocusChamberHint: Distance from focus to the chamber during the test.
fields.dFocusSkinHint: Patient entrance reference point (typically 15 cm above the table for under-table tubes, 30 cm from the receptor for over-table).
fields.alarmMinutesHint: When the accumulated-fluoroscopy alarm sounds. Should be ≤ 5 min per IN 91.

fluoroscopy.empty: Enter integrated chamber dose and exposure time to see the dose-rate calculation.

footer.l1: Rate at chamber [mGy/min] = chamber dose × 60 / exposure time
footer.l2: Rate at entrance = rate at chamber × (D<sub>focus–chamber</sub> / D<sub>focus–entrance</sub>)²
footer.l3: IN 91 / RDC 330 caps at the entrance reference point: 50 mGy/min (manual), 100 mGy/min (automatic), 200 mGy/min (high-rate). Accumulated-time alarm must trigger at ≤ 5 min.

kvp.title: kVp accuracy
kvp.description: Per-shot kVp deviation against the selected nominal value, plus reproducibility across the shot series. IN 56 tolerances: ±10% per shot for accuracy; ±5% reproducibility.
kvp.empty: Enter the nominal kVp and at least one measured shot to see the analysis.

footer.l2: Reproducibility = (max − min) / mean across the shot series

hvl.title: HVL — half-value layer
hvl.description: Compares the measured half-value layer against the IN 56/2019 minimum for the kVp setting and rectifier type. Linear interpolation between tabulated kVp rows.

validation.enterMeasured: Enter the measured HVL to compare.

hvl.empty: Enter the kVp setting to look up the IN 56 minimum HVL.

footer.l1: HVL minimum is interpolated between the IN 56/2019 Annex 2 table rows for the selected rectifier type. Coverage: 50–130 kVp.
footer.l2: Verdict: pass if measured ≥ minimum; fail if 80–100% of minimum; restricted if < 80%.

output.title: Tube output
output.description: Tube output normalised to 1 metre and (optionally) to a reference kVp. Compares against the IN 56 / IN 90 acceptable range for conventional radiography.

fields.applyKvpHint: Normalises the output to the reference kVp via inverse-square.
fields.dfdHint: Distance the dose rate was measured at.

note.title: Note
note.body: The IN 56 range is for conventional radiography at the reference kVp. Dental intraoral typically reads higher and has no published cap; treat the verdict as informational outside the conventional context.

output.empty: Enter dose rate, current and focus–detector distance.

footer.l2: The (FDD/100)² term scales the measurement to 1 m. The (kVp ratio)² term normalises to a reference kVp using the standard tube-output kVp² scaling.

timer.title: Exposure timer
timer.description: Per-shot timer accuracy (measured vs selected) and reproducibility across the shot series. IN 56 tolerances: ±10% per shot for accuracy; ±5% reproducibility.
timer.empty: Enter at least one selected/measured time pair.

footer.l2: Reproducibility = (max − min) / mean across the shot series

leakage.title: Leakage radiation
leakage.description: Leakage dose rate from the tube housing at 1 m, computed from a chamber reading at any distance and the exposure duration. Tested under maximum-load conditions (max kVp + max continuous mA). Limit: 1 mGy/h per IN 56 / IEC 60601-1-3.

fields.distanceHint: Where the chamber sat during the measurement.

leakage.empty: Enter measurement distance, chamber dose and exposure time.

footer.l1: Rate at distance = chamber dose × 3600 / exposure time
footer.l2: Rate at 1 m = rate at distance × (distance / 100)²
footer.l3: The (distance/100)² term scales the measurement to 1 m via inverse square. Test must be performed at the maximum continuous tube load specified by the manufacturer.
